[[File:Hobgoblin icon.png|left]]
'''Hobgoblins''' are [[Bandos]]ian creatures that share characteristics with both [[goblin]]s and [[ork]]s. They can be [[aggressiveness|aggressive]] to lower-level players, especially when several are in the area. This unique variant of hobgoblin can only be found in the [[God Wars Dungeon]]. When killed, they will increase the player's [[Killcount#Bandos|Bandos killcount]].

In the quest [[Fur 'n Seek]], a [[hobgoblin skin]] must be collected and cleaned for the [[Odd Old Man]].

When killing hobgoblins, an [[hobgoblin (elite)|elite]] version may spawn (guaranteed while on a [[Slayer assignment]]); the chance of spawn can be increased with the use of [[fellstalk incense stick]]s.

==Characteristics and history==
{{Main|Hobgoblin#Characteristics and history}}
Hobgoblins are said to be similar to a cross between [[Goblin (monster)|goblins]] and [[ork]]s. They possess characteristics of both races, with the pointed ears and height of goblins and the tusks and physique of orks.

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Magic ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Early-Game Rebalance|date=16 February 2026}}
** A number of early-game mobs will once again drop actual armour, weapons, ores, and bars.
*** Tiny spiky iron salvage → Iron sword/Iron off hand sword
*** Tiny spiky steel salvage → Steel dagger/Steel off hand dagger
*** Small bladed steel salvage → Steel longsword/Steel off hand longsword

* {{UL|type=update|update=Tuska Clean Up - This Week In RuneScape|date=18 August 2025}}
** The Sacrifice, Devotion, and Transfigure abilities have been removed from the God Wars Dungeon I loot table, and are now obtained by completing the One Piercing Note quest.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Housing of Parliament &amp; Double XP- This Week In RuneScape|date=12 February 2024}}
** Rebalanced several low level monsters that were harder to kill than intended

* {{UL|type=ninja|update=Patch Notes (11 January 2016)|date=11 January 2016}}
** Hobgoblins around the world have had their models updated to match the [[God Wars Dungeon|God Wars dungeon]] hobgoblins.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Woodcutting Rebalance|date=23 September 2009}}
** Hobgoblins have been graphically updated.
}}

==Trivia==
* A {{WP|hobgoblin}} is a household spirit from British folklore, being a more intelligent and helpful versions of {{wp|goblin}}s.
* In Armies of Gielinor hobgoblins are described as: "The hobgoblin occupies the rung on the evolutionary ladder between goblin and ork, and so displays the best and worst traits of both races."
* According to the [[Runescape Official Handbook]], hobgoblins keep their teeth sharp so they can eat their opponent.
* As of [[30 January]] [[2023]], hobgoblin Slayer assignments had the highest completion rate with over 99%.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Sponge|url=https://twitter.com/JagexSponge/status/1620148676239958018|date=30 January 2023|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/100367|archivedate=1 March 2023|quote=[Stat of the day (kinda) Which slayer task do you think has the highest completion rate (by percentage)?] Hobgoblins, the answer was hobgoblins. With above 99% completion rate.}}
